1.f1.name: Generous Cut
1.f1.text: Tithe Cut gives 0.2 more blood per MP it tears out, per rank.
1.f1._not: engine-dev 2026-11-17 (Redtithe eşlemesi; Ömer onayı bekler, open-questions Q-NEW Redtithe): MP çalma payı (gainRatio +%10) -> MP başına kan (bloodPerMp 2 x %10 = +0,2). Eski metin: Mana Steal gives you 10% more of the burned MP per rank.

1.f2.name: Deep Pockets
1.f2.text: Tithe Cut +8% damage per rank against enemies above half MP.

1.f3.name: Deep Cut
1.f3.text: Tithe Cut also tears out 3% of the target's max MP per rank.

1.n0.name: Prying Blade
1.n0.text: Tithe Cut removes one random buff from its target.

1.r.name: Bare Steel
1.r.text: Tithe Cut deals 2% increased damage per rank against enemies with no buffs.

1.eb.name: Quickening Steal
1.eb.text: If Tithe Cut's target is at 0 MP, the ally with the least MP gains Haste for 1 turn.

1.ma.name: Drink Deep
1.ma.text: Tithe Cut also heals you for 30% of the MP it tears out.

1.fa.name: Drained Dry
1.fa.text: Tithe Cut tears out 50% more MP, but deals no damage.

1.fb.name: Hurried Hands

1.mb.name: Tempo Thief
1.mb.text: If Tithe Cut empties its target, your next turn comes 8% sooner.

1.v.name: Spellsplitter
1.v.text: Tithe Cut becomes Spellsplitter: it removes every buff from its target and deals 8% more damage per buff removed.
